Question 5
?

Find the Cartesian equation of the parabola defined by the parametric equations

x+3=−3t2,y+5=−6t,t∈(−∞,∞).

a
(y+3)2=12(x+5)
b
(y+5)2=12(x+3)
c
(y+3)2=−12(x+5)
d
(y+5)2=−12(x+3)
e
(x+3)2=−12(y+5)
